reapack.name: Note Fixer.lua
reapack.desc: Note Fixer: measure sample libraries, fix note timing and volume

metadata.description: Measure Libraries plays every key of your sample libraries (SINE, Kontakt, Spitfire, Engine, Synchron and others) at several dynamics, articulation by articulation, on a new track, and notes down how late and how loud each note really sounds. It reads the keyswitches from BabylonWaves Art Conductor maps for Cubase and Logic, and from Reaticulate banks. Fix Selected Items then moves the notes of MIDI items so each sound lands where it was written, and evens out notes recorded too loud or too quiet. Needs ReaImGui.

version.author: kallums
version.changelog: First release. Measure Libraries: add an instrument from a track with a patch loaded, list its articulations and how each is chosen (keyswitch, CC, program change or MIDI channel) and whether its dynamics follow velocity or CC1, and press Measure All. Each test runs on a new track, rendered offline, and is removed afterwards. Fix Selected Items: moves each note by its own key and dynamic's delay, chosen by the articulation in force, and changes velocity (or CC11 for long notes) where a key is too loud or too quiet. Undo puts it back. Needs ReaImGui.

version.author: kallums
version.changelog: Import Articulations: read the keyswitches from a BabylonWaves Art Conductor map for Cubase (.expressionmap) or Logic (.plist), any Cubase expression map or Logic articulation set, or a Reaticulate bank (.reabank) - combinations of keyswitches, keyswitch velocity (Spitfire UACC KS), CCs, program changes and channels, with a guess at each articulation's dynamics. Keys used as keyswitches are never played as test notes. A Library name for each instrument. Profiles keep everything the test finds: where each note's sound starts, where its attack is heard and when it's done, every take, the keys the patch plays, and a summary; Library.json lists them all. Fix Selected Items follows combinations of keyswitches and Reaticulate's articulation numbers. Profiles from 1.0 still work.
